author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Experience the authentic taste of village life with this unique way of cooking fresh carp 🔥🐟 In this video, the fish is prepared and slowly cooked inside an underground tandoor, bringing out deep, rich flavors you won’t find anywhere else.

The carp turns incredibly tender on the inside with a perfectly roasted, slightly smoky crust on the outside. Cooking underground locks in moisture and gives the fish a natural, earthy aroma that makes every bite unforgettable.

This traditional method is all about patience and simplicity. Using fire, earth, and fresh ingredients, it reflects true village cooking — natural, flavorful, and deeply satisfying.

#villagecooking #tandoorcooking #freshfish #traditionalfood #outdoorcooking
title: Cooking Fresh Carp in an Underground Tandoor – True Village Flavor 🔥🐟
